posts.title: The Problem with Mental States of Language Models
posts.description: Asking whether language models have human mental states is the wrong question.

posts.title: Interesting LLM behaviors are exactly those for which there is no "robust algorithm"
posts.description: LLMs are useful and interesting precisely because they can perform tasks for which robust algorithms are elusive.

posts.title: World Models and Consistent Mistakes in LLMs
posts.description: LLMs make consistent mistakes when given prompts that are rephrased or in another language. However, when given a substantially different prompt that relies on the same information, LLMs often give inconsistent answers.
